item.title: Leon W. Moore
item.description: COLERAIN – Leon Wendell Moore, 70, of Colerain died Tuesday, January 20, 2026 at ECU Health Medical Center, Greenville. Funeral services will be held at 11 a.m. on Saturday, January 31, 2026 at Greater Wynns Grove Baptist Church, Colerain. Burial will follow in Highland Memorial Gardens, Ahoskie. Wilder’s Chapel of Windsor is handling the arrangements.

item.title: Patricia B. Vinson
item.description: NEWPORT NEWS, VA – Patricia Ann Boswell Vinson, 82, of Newport News, VA, died Saturday, January 24, 2026 in Williamsburg, VA. Funeral services will be held at 2 p.m. on Friday, January 30, 2026 at Meherrin Baptist Church, Murfreesboro. A private burial will follow in the church cemetery. Garrett-Sykes Memorial Chapel, Murfreesboro, is handling the arrangements.

item.title: Coastal Land Trust is a Godsend to our area
item.description: Black bears don’t know when they’ve crossed from Virginia to North Carolina—they just know there’s a wildlife corridor of forested land where they can roam freely. item.title: ACS girls rally late in 4th quarter to win in overtime
item.description: AHOSKIE – Myah Bradley connected on two clutch baskets in overtime as Ahoskie Christian School defeated Mt. Calvary Christian Academy, 46-41, on Thursday night. Ahoskie Christian trailed by four (37-33) with just under one minute remaining in regulation. Kinsley Dunlow hit a clutch shot of her own, draining a three-pointer from the left corner to get her team to within 37-36 with 23 seconds left.
